changelog.change: Created the fixed six-case labeling pilot subset with empty label and prediction packets.

label_packet_state.reason: No real synthetic model-teacher adjudication run exists for this pilot subset: the frozen corpus does not check in reviewed diff bytes and no teacher run has been retained. Human packets are optional. Empty packets are intentional; they are not negative or clean labels.

relabeling.policy: A relabel creates a new packet version and a new labels file; prior packet files are retained and never mutated.

selection.rule: fixed purposive subset: one case per repository per split from frozen-corpus-v1; identities copied unchanged
